raw: SELECT SUM(t.fare_amount / t.trip_distance) / COUNT(*) FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.zone LIKE 'Manhattan%'
sql: SELECT SUM(t.fare_amount / t.trip_distance) / COUNT(*) FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.zone LIKE 'Manhattan%'

raw: SELECT vendor_id FROM trips GROUP BY vendor_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
sql: SELECT vendor_id FROM trips GROUP BY vendor_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

raw: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Queens' AND strftime('%w', t.pickup_datetime) IN (6, 7)
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Queens' AND strftime('%w', t.pickup_datetime) IN (6, 7)

raw: SELECT dz.zone FROM trips t JOIN zones dz ON t.do_location_id = dz.location_id JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.zone = 'JFK Airport' GROUP BY dz.zone ORDER BY COUNT(t.trip_id) DESC LIMIT 1
sql: SELECT dz.zone FROM trips t JOIN zones dz ON t.do_location_id = dz.location_id JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.zone = 'JFK Airport' GROUP BY dz.zone ORDER BY COUNT(t.trip_id) DESC LIMIT 1

raw: SELECT pz.zone, SUM(t.tip_amount) AS total_tips FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Brooklyn' GROUP BY pz.zone ORDER BY total_tips DESC LIMIT 3
sql: SELECT pz.zone, SUM(t.tip_amount) AS total_tips FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Brooklyn' GROUP BY pz.zone ORDER BY total_tips DESC LIMIT 3

raw: SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) AS hour FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id GROUP BY hour ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) AS hour FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id GROUP BY hour ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

raw: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips WHERE tip_amount > fare_amount;
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips WHERE tip_amount > fare_amount;

raw: SELECT AVG(t.fare_amount) FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Queens' AND t.payment_type = 2;
sql: SELECT AVG(t.fare_amount) FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Queens' AND t.payment_type = 2;

raw: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pu_location_id = z.location_id WHERE z.borough = 'Manhattan' GROUP BY z.location_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) AS subquery
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips t JOIN zones z ON t.pu_location_id = z.location_id WHERE z.borough = 'Manhattan' GROUP BY z.location_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) AS subquery

raw: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.trip_distance > 20 AND (t.do_location_id = (SELECT location_id FROM zones WHERE zone = 'JFK Airport') OR t.do_location_id = (SELECT location_id FROM zones WHERE zone = 'LaGuardia Airport') OR t.do_location_id = (SELECT location_id FROM zones WHERE zone = 'Newark Airport')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM trips t;
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.trip_distance > 20 AND (t.do_location_id = (SELECT location_id FROM zones WHERE zone = 'JFK Airport') OR t.do_location_id = (SELECT location_id FROM zones WHERE zone = 'LaGuardia Airport') OR t.do_location_id = (SELECT location_id FROM zones WHERE zone = 'Newark Airport')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM trips t;

raw: SELECT AVG((julianday(t.dropoff_datetime) - julianday(t.pickup_datetime)) * 1440) FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Queens' AND CAST(strftime('%H', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 4;
sql: SELECT AVG((julianday(t.dropoff_datetime) - julianday(t.pickup_datetime)) * 1440) FROM trips t JOIN zones pz ON t.pu_location_id = pz.location_id WHERE pz.borough = 'Queens' AND CAST(strftime('%H', t.pickup_datetime) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 4;
